description: This file defines React hook functions related to managing stock data, including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting stock entries. It includes helper functions for normalizing input data and building query parameters, and exports custom hooks for interacting with a REST API.

methods.name: normalizeStockList(payload)
methods.description: Normalizes various backend stock list response shapes into a standardized array of stock items.

methods.name: normalizeStockEntry(item)
methods.description: Transforms a raw stock item object into a normalized format suitable for UI display, handling fallback fields and type conversions.

methods.name: buildQuery({ dealerId, q } = {})
methods.description: Constructs a query object for API requests, omitting empty parameters.

methods.name: useStockList({ dealerId, q } = {})
methods.description: Custom React hook that fetches the list of stock items with optional filtering by dealerId and search query.

methods.name: useCreateStockEntry()
methods.description: Custom React hook for creating new stock entries via POST request.

methods.name: useUpdateStockEntry(stockId)
methods.description: Custom React hook for updating a specific stock entry identified by stockId via PUT request.

methods.name: useDeleteStockEntry(stockId)
methods.description: Custom React hook for deleting a specific stock entry identified by stockId via DELETE request.
